name: Potion Cauldron
desc: Restores all HP to the whole party.

name: Ether Fountain
desc: Restores 40 MP to the whole party.

name: Heartstone
desc: Raises maximum HP by 15, for good.

name: Wellstone
desc: Raises maximum MP by 8, for good.

name: Revival Feather
desc: Brings a fallen ally back with half their HP.

name: Attack Mirror
desc: Reflects every physical attack at the party until your next turn.

name: Magic Mirror
desc: Reflects every spell cast at the party until your next turn.

name: Venom Flask
desc: Throws a vial of poison at an enemy.

name: Flash Powder
desc: Blinds an enemy, halving its agility.

name: Fire Bomb
desc: Hurls a flaming explosive. Effective vs. fire-weak foes.

name: Ice Shard
desc: Throws a razor-sharp sliver of ice. Effective vs. ice-weak foes.

name: Thunder Bead
desc: Discharges a crackling orb. Effective vs. thunder-weak foes.
